notes.title: Development update(4621078)
notes.content:
Fix

Initial notes are not processed correctly



Various problems occurred while changing the way the character moves, and the related problems were fixed.
I'm currently trying various things to complement the simple pattern of one button.

Characters can now move from one direction to many.
The game has the ability to add predesigned maps in addition to randomly generated maps.

I'm currently testing, but there will be a lot of changes in the trap as well.

If you give us your feedback, we will try to reflect it in the game without digging.
Thank you.

notes.title: Character Editing Mode Update(4507495)
notes.content:
Added character mode editing. 

Through the editor, the user can customize it or change it to a completely different character. 

I plan to add it later so that I can download it from the Steam Workshop and experience the creations of other users. It will take a while, but I think it's a good idea to add map editing later.
